description: Confirm and lock a purchase invoice without changing approved totals. Purchases before full VAT registration require explicit owner review of historical deduction. Totals correction requires a fresh approved preview.

pre_registration_vat_deduction_approved.description: Only after owner review of a purchase dated before full VAT registration: false = no input-VAT deduction (non-deductible rows required); true = owner approved a statutory deduction exception. Omit to hold for review.

name: confirm_purchase_invoice
title: Confirm Purchase Invoice
